newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka stocks end low in trade led by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka stocks end low in trade led by blue chips.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed a shade lower on Monday despite foreign buying of select blue chips, brokers said.
The all share index, which began correcting on Thursday, closed 1.4 points down at 791.9. Blue chips Hayleys fell three rupees to 255, Richard Pieris & Co three to 135.
"Profit-taking is continuing, but the downside is limited because the fundamentals are very good," said Ajit Dias Wanigasekera of Ceylinco Stock Brokers.
Turnover was 76.4 million rupees, led by foreign buying of 104,400 shares of the blue chip John Keells Holdings.
